register.labelZh: STAND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: stand by somebody 表示在某人面對困難時繼續支持對方;stand up for somebody 則表示在對方受到不公平對待時維護他。；stand up to 可以表示某人拒絕接受欺凌、威嚇、壓力或惡劣對待。；stand back、stand around、stand over、stand up 和 stand out 可以幫助你描述人物的位置、動作,以及某物是否顯眼。；stand in 表示暫時代替某人;stand for 用來解釋意思;stand down 表示退任;stand between 則表示成為障礙。
register.summaryEn: Stand by somebody shows that you continue supporting a person during a difficult time. Stand up for somebody shows that you defend them when they are treated unfairly. Stand up to can show that someone refuses to accept bullying, threats, pressure or bad treatment. Stand back, stand around, stand over, stand up and stand out help you describe where people are, how they move and whether something is easy to notice. Stand in describes temporarily replacing somebody. Stand for explains a meaning. Stand down describes leaving a position, while stand between describes an obstacle.
contextsZh: 描述位置、動作和顯眼程度
contextsEn: Talk clearly about support and loyalty
Talk about roles, meanings and obstacles
